scenes.text: Two *21-year-olds* built a *$13 million* study app with cookies

scenes.title: Who: *Rudy Arora & Sarthak Dhawan*, 21
lines: Met in middle school near Dallas. Northwestern and Duke freshmen in fall 2023.
Launched Turbo AI in January 2024: an AI note-taker for students.
Both dropped out. "Looking back, I think we dropped out a little late."

scenes.title: The *cookie* trick
lines: First 1,000 users came from handing out cookies in the dining hall.
Arora posted TikToks three to four times a day.
Paid friends and small creators $5 a video, plus a bonus if it went viral.

scenes.title: The *AI* part
lines: Turbo turns lectures and PDFs into notes, flashcards and quizzes.
Dhawan's favorite tool now is Claude Code. "I can feel my coding skills atrophying."
Team of about ten, six of them engineers.

scenes.title: The *numbers*
lines: Five million users, about 20,000 new ones a day. Profitable.
Raised $750,000. Students pay about $20 a month.

scenes.title: The *lesson*
lines: No ad budget at the start. Cookies, TikToks and $5 creators did the work.
Build for the campus you're standing on.
Business Insider, as told to Agnes Applegate, June 29, 2026; TechCrunch, Oct 23, 2025.

scenes.text: Want the *$5-a-video* creator playbook? Comment *CREATORS* and follow.
